name: surfaces-atlas
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: production 3D game material texture atlas, PBR base colour only.
Primary request: Generate an original square 2048 x 2048 pixel image with exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of equally sized square material panels. This is a technical texture asset that will be sampled by a fixed 4x4 grid, with panel boundaries at precisely 25%, 50%, and 75% of width and height. Each panel fills all its allocated area, with zero gutters and zero drawn grid borders. Flat orthographic materials photographed head-on or straight-down, entirely planar, uniform diffuse lighting, no directional shadows, no highlights, no perspective, no objects.
Panel order is mandatory, left to right:
ROW 1: weathered grey concrete; warm chipped beige plaster; pale stratified limestone; dark aged brick.
ROW 2: worn charcoal asphalt with tiny aggregate; brown compact dirt and small pebbles; pale desert sand; cool loose gravel.
ROW 3: near-black machined anodised gunmetal with fine wear; matte dark olive woven tactical fabric; weathered wooden boards; rusted ochre corrugated steel.
ROW 4: moss and ground litter; desaturated dry grass ground; reddish terracotta roof tiles; rough dark-grey rock.
Style: convincing photoreal microstructure and large-scale wear, sharp physically believable material detail at multiple scales. Realistic tropical/arid tactical shooter material palette; all original artwork.
Constraints: no labels, letters, numerals, logos, text, watermarks, inset frames, separators, empty margins, props, weapons, UI, scene composition, or mockup screenshot. Exactly sixteen panels in the stated positions.

name: foliage-atlas
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: production transparent foliage cutout atlas for 3D foliage cards.
Primary request: Generate an original square 2048 x 2048 pixel PNG with GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND. Exactly TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, four equal quadrant cells. No visible grid, no opaque background. Each botanical subject must be centred entirely inside its own quadrant with a transparent margin around all outer edges, never overlapping another quadrant.
TOP LEFT: one isolated broad bush leafy canopy.
TOP RIGHT: one long arching palm frond with many slender leaflets, the frond aligned mostly vertically.
BOTTOM LEFT: several upright clumps of thin dry-green grass.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one wild leafy fern shrub.
Style: photoreal leaf detail, naturally irregular foliage silhouette, warm natural olive greens with dry-green variation, realistic tropical/arid tactical shooter vegetation. Original artwork. Flat front-view cutout suitable for alpha-tested game cards, evenly lit foliage with no cast shadow.
Constraints: actual zero-alpha empty pixels surrounding every plant, no checkerboard baked into the image, no pots, no soil base, no surrounding scene, no labels, text, watermarks, frames, or UI. Preserve transparency between leaflets and leaves. Four isolated subjects in their mandatory positions.

name: horizon
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: production 3D environment panorama for a sky sphere.
Primary request: Generate an original seamless horizontally wrapping wide 2:1 landscape panorama, exactly 2048 x 1024 pixels. The left and right edges must join smoothly in sky colour, cloud distribution, mountain elevations and foothill tones, with no visible seam.
Scene: natural high-altitude partly cloudy blue sky occupying the upper 75% of the image. Remote sunlit rugged limestone mountains and hazy green arid foothills occupy the bottom 25%, with a low natural horizon. Warm late-afternoon sunlight comes from the upper right. Natural pale atmospheric haze at the distant horizon, crisp convincing photographic cloud and mountain details. Realistic tropical/arid tactical shooter environment aesthetic.
Composition: panoramic environment texture, wide open sky, mountain ridge stays low, no foreground framing objects or large foreground cliffs. Intended to wrap around the player in 3D.
Constraints: no buildings, people, weapons, text, watermark, borders, UI, or mock-up screenshot. Original landscape, no copied game artwork.
